articleTitle: A New Risk Assessment Model for E-Government Network Security Based on Antibody Concentration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Risk assessment is one of the most important issues in the field of e-Government network security. Inspired by the principles of biological immune system, a new risk assessment model for e-Government network security, referred to as ACENS, is proposed in this paper. In ACENS, the artificial lymphocytes are used for assessing the risk of e-Government network security, and the lymphocytes' concentration changes with the trend of the real attack intensity. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that ACENS is valid, and it has the features of real time and self-adaptive. Thus, it provides a good solution to risk assessment for e-Government network security.

articleTitle: Fitting and Prediction for Crack Propagation Rate Based on Machine Learning Optimal Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Establishing fatigue crack propagation rate is the key to forecasting structure fatigue lifetime, nine parameters fatigue crack propagation rate model and McEvily model are widely applied at present, but it is very complex to realize these models, partial derivative must be calculated and there is large deviation between fitted static parameter and actual value and physical conception isn't clear. In accordance with the disadvantage above methods, Based on optimum parameter selection with grid search and cross validation, we presented optimal common machine learning algorithm (least squares support vector machine-LSSVM) method for fatigue crack propagation rate forecast. Complicated and strong nonlinear fatigue crack propagation rate curve was simulated by network design and conformation of LSSVM learning algorithm and the optimized SVM parameters were selected by the method of network searching and cross validation. Compared the errors with output value of the optimized model and output value from nine parameters fatigue crack propagation rate fitting model, LSSVM whose parameter was optimized with cross validation had excellent ability of nonlinear modeling and generalization. It provided a simple and feasible intelligent approach for material fatigue analysis.

Author Keywords: nine parameters fatigue crack propagation rate model

articleTitle: Measure Semantic Distance in WordNet Based on Directed Graph Search
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Many researchers make use of WordNet to measure semantic distance, but rarely describe and, further more, analyze an algorithm which is in specialty to find paths, called semantic relations in this paper, between two concepts in WordNet. Searching in all semantic relations is an important step in measuring semantic similarity. In this paper, we propose two algorithms, HS (hierarchy spread) and BDOS (bidirection one step), to search the relation with shortest semantic distance in WordNet. HS takes Hyponym and Hypernym into consideration at first, while BDOS searches semantic relations from two start concepts and dealing with all four relations at the same time. Moreover, dynamic threshold is brought in BDOS to control path expansion iteration. After experiments, we make astatistic analysis and comparison between these two algorithms and another approach which is proposed earlier for measuring semantic similarity by researcher named Yang. The experiments show that BDOS gives a better performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: Forecast of Regional Gross National Product Based on Grey Modelling Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Regional gross national product (GDP) is an important indicator of national economic accounting. Regional GDP is an important part of the country's GDP, and it is of great significance for formulating scientifically the strategy and the policy of regional development that to effectively forecast regional GDP. A method based on genetic algorithm optimizing grey modeling process is introduced in this paper. This method makes full use of the advantages of the grey forecast model and characteristics of genetic algorithm to find global optimization. So the forecast model is more accurate. According to data from a province, the GM (1, 1) model for forecasting regional GDP was given based on the grey system theories and genetic algorithm. The result indicates that the model can be used as regional GDP an effective tool for forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on E-Learning Supporting System: A Review from the Perspective of Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) is supported by many strategies such as business intelligence, collaboration, document management and e-learning (E-L). Thus, it is urgent for organizations to design and develop an E-L system with advanced technologies. The review of basic technologies that support E-L will be in favor of further study on E-L. From perspective of KM, is paper makes a review about the definition of E-L, the relationship between E-L and KM and advanced technologies that support the design and operation of E-L system. Considering the importance of China in developing the technology of E-L, we especially introduce the current development condition of E-L in China. At the end of this paper, we analyze the main trends of the development direction of E-L technology.

articleTitle: Design of a Network Virtual Laboratory System for Digital Signal Processing Experiments
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: A network virtual laboratory system for digital signal processing experiments based on LabVIEW is introduced. The system provides the users with virtual reality of experimental environment, convenient operation and powerful simulation capability. By combining database and network technology, a network virtual experiment teaching management system is developed. The system realizes the sharing of hardware resources and it is suitable for distance education. The virtual laboratory system has been implemented in Beijing Union University and has achieved positive evaluation.

articleTitle: Social Network Analysis in IT Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The goal of social network analysis is to study human relations and social structures. This article first introduces the concept of social network analysis and then discusses the analysis steps in detail with the illustration of two companies. Finally this article draws a conclusion by comparing the different business processes after using the social network analysis approach design.

articleTitle: Research of Heterogeneous Database Integration Based on XML and JAVA Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Aiming at using different types of heterogeneous database system for enterprises and institutions, we design and implement a global data management and query processing in heterogeneous database information processing system in Intranet, The system adopts structs techniques of MVC pattern, and use JAVA component technology in Enterprise Java Bean component technology to implement the MVC pattern in models. This paper describes the system’s work flow, and analyses its implementation details of core modules theoretically.

articleTitle: Classification of Semantic Documents Based on WordNet
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: There are a lot benefits to enable intelligent agent understanding the information from semantic web. It enhances the efficiency of information usage and at the same time, suffices the need of users. Semantic documents contain adequate semantic information which helps understanding. However, discrepancy between ontology which is an interpreter of semantic document prevents the share of knowledge. In this paper, we proposed a uniform representation for the content, which include concepts and relations, of semantic documents based on WordNet. First, disambiguation is preceded within the key words in a document for the purpose of mapping them to concepts. Then we present the whole document in the form of concept graph that Levenshtein Distance could be applied for making a classification of documents. We have empirical result that this methodology makes a promising raise in accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Management Information System of Processing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: With the development and gradual application of information technology and network technique, management information system is becoming a necessary tool for enterprise participating in international competition. The paper firstly generally introduced the characteristics of processing enterprises that include production processing enterprises and brand marketing enterprises. Secondly, the paper analyzed the entire function of management information system of processing enterprise, and finally designed in detail the purchasing management and marketing management system based on internet, which will provide some helpful thoughts and practicable measures for informationization construction of processing enterprises.

articleTitle: The State-of-the-Art Review of Structural Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Structural control is one of the most promising strategies for the field of structural vibration. Based on the basic characteristics of the structural vibration control, the categories of structural control method are introduced. The control algorithms are systematically reviewed from the aspects including active control, semi-active control, and neural-fuzzy control. Finally, the existed problem in application and the future developing in research on the structural control method are summarized respectively.

articleTitle: Status, Function and Development Trend of Distance Education in the Rural Areas of China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Distance education is an important way to construct the lifelong learning system in the knowledge-based economy age, and it is of great education and economy value in rural areas all over the world. In combination with the actual situation in distance education development in China, In this paper, it illustrated the function of distance education in China's new rural construction, problems in rural distance education are comprehensively analyzed. And its corresponding countermeasures were proposed. And more, the development trend of rural distance education is prospected.

articleTitle: Arbitrary Waveform Generator Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The conventional signal generators are often unable to produce the specific or complex signals. An arbitrary waveform generator has been designed with LabVIEW and virtual instrumentation technology. The generator not only can produce sine wave, triangle wave and other conventional waveform, but also can generate a variety of demanding modulated signals and M sequence signals. Even more, it can produce the special signals through fitting data, input formula and hand drawing by mouse. This virtual instrumentation achieves the aim that produces arbitrary waveform and meets the needing of specific experimental or complex condition.

articleTitle: Improving Hilditch Thinning Algorithms for Text Image
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Hilditch thinning algorithm is widely used in image pre-processing process. In this paper, we propose an improved Hilditch algorithm to acquire a more stable output. We conclude that the skeletons obtained from our algorithms give better results in Chinese characters and numbers. The advantage of this algorithm corrects the beard by modifying the warp in the part of intersection.

articleTitle: A Novel Fractal Image Coding Based on Basis Block Dictionary
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Long encoding time is the bottleneck in the developing of fractal image coding. Although some improved methods are proposed, the contradiction between encoding time and decoding quality is a still ubiquitous problem. To solve this problem, a novel fractal image coding method based on basis block dictionary is proposed. Multi-component dictionary, which is over-complete, is built under the generative framework by sparse coding. It optimizes the structure of domain pool in fractal coding, and improves the speed of fractal encoding greatly. Finally, the experiments prove the effectiveness and practicality of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of the Listed Company's Financial Position Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, the index weight is definite based on entropy weight method and subjective assignment method, combining the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, the financial position of the company is evaluated for the operators, investors and provides basis for decision-making such stakeholders.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an E-Learning Model Based on WUM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: E-learning online system which is well-known as its convenient, flexible mode and cheap investment is becoming a new way for people to receive education. How can build an intelligent and personalized learning platform for learners is required today. Web usage mining (WUM) by analyzing the potential rules hidden in Web logs can help personalize the delivery of Web content and improve Web design, customer satisfaction and user navigation through pre-fetching and caching. WUM as one of the hottest techniques in Web data mining can provide an intelligent and individual platform for learners. This paper introduces how to use WUM techniques in e-learning . It designs and implements an e-learning model based on WUM techniques in detail. Implementing the model can build a more intelligent and individual learning system and promote the interests of learners.

articleTitle: Rotor Speed Identification of Doubly-Fed Generator System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: According to the mathematic model of doubly-fed induction generator, the adjustable model and reference model based on MRAS are found. The adjustable model of model reference adaptive system based on neural network is derived by backward differentiation method and the algorithm for magnetic flux linkage is determined using two-layer neural network . Besides, the speed identification of doubly-fed induction generator is obtained by training of two-layer neural network using error back propagation. Finally, the simulation results show that compared with the speed identification of model reference adaptive system, the rotor speed can be reflected actually, and the speed estimation precision is effectively improved when neural network speed estimator is applied.

articleTitle: A New Intelligent Design Method for Building Material Fatigue S-N Curve
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: It is the basis of material fatigue reliability analysis to obtain fatigue S-N curve, The curve is usually obtained from experiment or by fitting many data of loading test basis on three parameters empirical formula, but those methods are complex, high expense and imprecision. In accordance with these disadvantages above methods, a new intelligent method based on common machine learning algorithm (support vector machine) is presented to obtain S-N curve of material fatigue economically and effectively. Complicated and strong nonlinear S-N curve was simulated by design and conformation of support vector machine learning algorithm, compared the errors with output value of the intelligent model, test value and output value from fitting values of three parameters power function, support vector machine learning algorithm had excellent ability of nonlinear modeling and generalization. It gained high precision under limited learning samples and mean relative error is 0.008954%, it provided an economical, practical and reliable approach for material fatigue design.

Author Keywords: Optimized support vector machine learning algorithm

articleTitle: Students' Conceptions of Online ESL Education in Chinese HE: A Phenomenographic Study
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: With the development of information technology and its application to education, online ESL educational reform was initiated by the Ministry of Education in China, aiming at student centered and individualized ESL education in HE based on the application of information technology, network technology in particular. Studies have been conducted in this field yet there has been no in-depth study on how learners experience and understand online ESL education. In this study, the authors set out to investigate and depict Chinese higher education students' conceptions of online ESL education with a phenomenographic approach. Three conceptual categories have been identified from the analysis namely online autonomous learning, face-to-face lectures, and social relations in online settings. Impact of traditional Chinese educational system has also been discussed to give more insights into the analysis results. It is concluded that there is still a long way to go to achieve student centered learning and for a considerable period of time the hybrid learning style combining lectures and online learning will be a major educational style in Chinese ESL courses.

articleTitle: Grid Analysis Environment Service Architecture for Structured Modeling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Structured Modeling is a common modeling method. Modeling analysis in Structured Modeling is complex, difficult and time-consuming. This paper proposed the service architecture under Grid analysis environment for SM that is ideally suited to Semantic Web applications. Based on WSDL, OWL-S, FIPA, and OGSA, extending existing Grid paradigms to harness emerging Web service technologies such as SOAP, WSDL and BPEL, a concise overview of Grid middleware for SM is provided. The functionality model, the Web service-based grid architecture for SM, and the logic function architecture of SM is proposed by this paper.

Author Keywords: OWL Web Ontology Language for Services

articleTitle: A Learning Approach for Fast Training of Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we propose a learning method for fast training of support vector machines (SVMs). First, we divide the two-class training samples into two sets according to the labels. Secondly, the two set one-class samples are trained by using one-class SVM (OCSVM) respectively, and we get two set support vectors (SVs). Finally, the two set SVs are combined into a set of two-class training samples and trained by normal SVM algorithm. The experimental results show the proposed method can improve the training speed and generate the simpler decision function, at the same time the accuracy is kept.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Business Logic Components of RFID Midware for Logistics Customs Clearance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed RFID middleware technology and its application in logistics customs clearance process. Based on this, we discussed the design tactic of business logic components in RFID midware for logistics customs clearance. Using data filtering, event aggregation and other technology, business logic components can turn the raw RFID data to valuable business information.

articleTitle: Study on Personality Learning in E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: E-learning is becoming one of the most important educational means. As more and more organizations and institutions are moving towards the e-learning strategy, personality-learning model becomes a big challenge. Learning styles, academic achievements and learning objectives of various groups of students on the network are very different. Personality learning system, which uses different learning programs for different students, can enhance the efficiency of learning process. Focusing on the personality learning, the article explores a new method that the net learning system exploits intelligent reasoning service to provide the learners with personalized teaching resources and teaching styles.

articleTitle: Speaker Normalization Method Based on the Piece-Wise Linear Frequency Warping
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In traditional vocal tract length normalization (VTLN) method, the details of the differences of spectral among speakers cannot be modeled, because only a simple vocal tract length factor is regarded as the absolutely indicator of the speaker specific attribute, according to the assumption of lossless multi-tube vocal tract model. In this paper, the piece-wise frequency warping function is adopted to describe the speaker specific character in detail. With an appropriate partition of frequency axis, the differences of spectral can be removed well. Due to the model-independent warping function, this method is proved to be a quite fast adaptation technique, and especially suitable for the unsupervised adaptation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Design and Implementation of Format Checker for E-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy-PID Control in Heating Furnace Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In view of the characteristics of nonlinear, time-variable, large hysteresis of the heating furnace, combined with the advantages and disadvantages of the PID control and the basic principles of fuzzy control, we designed the system which united the fuzzy control and the PID control. After the MATLAB simulation test, the system has the merits of good timeliness, quick speed of the control, the stable state precision is high, over small and so on.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of Learner Factor on E-Learning Quality
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government

articleTitle: Developing Web Archive for Digital Preservation of University
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In current world, the semantic Web is not just a medium for information and records carrying, but growing communities for people sharing knowledge. With rapid updating Webs, many Websites or pages died away due to lack for awareness of importance of Web archive. The demand of establishing Web archive system is pressing for. This paper is concerning the construction of an NTU (Nanyang Technological University of Singapore) Web archiving system. We aim to discuss the value of the Web archive system, mainly from a technical point of view, to evaluate the feasibility of such systems, and to realize the basic functions. The design tool is the selective capture approach, and certain software is used to realize this SCI Web archive system based on system testing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application of Classification Algorithm Based on Association Rules in the Labor Market
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government

articleTitle: The Design and Application of the Virtual Laboratory Technology Based on Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The virtual laboratory is a set of software system which simulates the real experiments by virtual reality technology. This paper has in detail analyzed the characteristic of the virtual laboratory. And the application in network by a virtual signal generator is introduced. A virtual function generator and a virtual oscillograph are designed and connected with each other base on network successfully.

articleTitle: Improving System Usability Model in E-Learning Based on System-Reasonable Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Suchman put the system reasonable into three parts: pragmaic, meral and cognitive. There are three parts of system usability model based on system reasonable theory such as business application system continuity, service system continuity and information communication system continuity.

articleTitle: The Research of Non-back Multi-words Matching Algorithm Based on Aggregate Address Inverted Index
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The generation of massive information makes the development and application of information retrieval technology become inevitable. The construction of the inverted index can complete the information retrieval effectively, but it didn't consider the accuracy and quickness of the information retrieval. The paper which based on the inverted technology put forward the aggregate addresses inverted index technology to complete the main design of the index system. The use of the improved relevance ranking algorithm and the non-back multi-words matching algorithm complete the main design of the query system. It can adjust the balance of the performance between index and query. The results of system tested indicate that has better universality, higher performance and better scalability of the scale.

articleTitle: On the Talents Cultivation and Evaluation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Gardner's multiple intelligence theory provides a new thought for the colleges' cultivation of talents by its rich educational content. The multiple intelligence theory enlightens us that the intelligence structure of the creative talents is an integrated system where various intelligence essential factors are realigned, maintaining close ties with each other and make the mode of thinking diversified. In this paper, in view of the problems in the talents training of computer professional, we combine multiple intelligence theory with the characteristics of computer science to optimize instructional design, condense course content, create multi-intelligence development environment, implement effective teaching method and teaching means and adopt variety of evaluation methods to cultivate student's comprehensive ability.

articleTitle: Resolution to Combinational Ambiguity of Chinese Word Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Chinese word segmentation ambiguity can be divided into two categories: overlapped ambiguity and combinational ambiguity. This paper only focuses on the resolution to combinational ambiguity of Chinese word segmentation. We select 36 typical combinational ambiguity strings, and make use of transformation-based learning methods to learn the rules of combinational ambiguity. Using these rules to test "People's Daily" Corpus of 1996, we find that the average precision rate is improved from 79.08% to 94.35%.

articleTitle: The Research of Fault Diagnosis in Incomplete Information Systems Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: There are many uncertainties and knowledge redundancy in fault diagnosis while the rough set theory is a new the mathematical tools to deal with the uncertainty of information. The rough set theory provides a a new effective way of dealing with the mechanical fault diagnosis . This paper presents a method of discretization which can be used in incomplete continuous information processing, and uses the weighted clustering method to determine breakpoints, and chooses breakpoints using the decision-making table's compatibility as standards. Experiments show that it is a satisfactory alternative method.

articleTitle: Application of CCD in CE
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Concurrent Engineering Design is a complex design system and designers have to concern every details. Among the countless aspects, collaborative-concurrent must be considered because of its importance. This paper discusses some approaches which are used in collaborative-concurrent design. Finally this article describes the advantages of the system characteristics by illustrating an airplane.

articleTitle: Intercultural Understanding of E-Learning: Case Study of eChina~UK Program
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Both China and UK have enjoyed fast development of e-learning and are beginning to look out to the world. Therefore, intercultural collaboration becomes indispensable and rewarding to both sides involved. Facing different cultures from those of one's own, a nation may come upon a lot of issues that hinder the success of collaboration yet at the same time can lead to insights into and innovations of diverse perspectives of e-learning. eChina~UK e-learning program is such an intercultural collaborative project. This paper draws experiences from eChina UK program and explores important themes in intercultural understanding of e-learning including differences in pedagogy, intercultural communication and collaboration, and issues of quality assurance (QA) and intellectual property rights (IPR). Conclusions are drawn from these experiences that although there are differences in pedagogy between China and UK, intercultural collaboration is of significance to both sides, in which process challenges like QA and IPR are to be met.

articleTitle: The Thoughts and Suggestions of the Virtual Teacher Adopted in Network Course Construction
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Based on e-learning principles, combining with the experiences of our college's network course construction and the problems found in teaching, we suggest importing the virtual teacher with affections and real-time communication functions into e-learning. This paper analyzes the virtual teacher's basic features and functions, discussing the methods and technologies in importing the virtual teacher into E-Learning. We believe this can effectively integrate the advantages of traditional teaching and E-Learning, significantly improving the teaching quality.

articleTitle: A Method of Using Interactive 3D Element in Flash Courseware
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Interactive 3D element is a difficult problem of multimedia courseware for a long time. The traditional method is using some special 3D tools or software to developing 3D function outside the courseware. It is inconvenient and poorly effective. This paper brings a new method, which allows interactive 3D elements to be added in Flash. The method is using ActionScript and Sandy library. 3D scene is created by Sandy APIs and managed by Flash functions. An example of engineering graphics courseware is illustrated to explain how this procedure is implemented. The example shows the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Shift-Share Analysis of Industrial Structure in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Study on Evaluation Index System of New-Type Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: It is an important task to achieve a new-type industrialization for China's economic construction at present, and it become a important subject that how to evaluate the level of new-type industrialization level for the government sector and the academia. In this paper, an evaluation index system of new-type industrialization is built from seven aspects those are development stage of industrialization, structural change, the scientific and technological content, economic benefits, resources and environmental conditions, the level of industrial enterprises in information and human resources utilization and labor productivity on the basis of concept of the new-type of industrialization and the principles of construction of evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Digital Signature Based on User Role Token and Its Application to E-Government
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Information is an irreversible general trend of social and world economy's development. E-government means to make full use of information technology to enhance the effective management of the government, in order to promote transformation of government functions and improve management level. However, e-government faces with some problems, such as security issues. First, this paper analyzes the characteristics of E-government system and points out its security threats. Then this paper gives outs an frame of E-government security system based on the user role certificates. In the end, the implementation model based on web service is described in detail.

articleTitle: Online Prediction and Intelligent Control for Structural Vibration Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Various semi-active control devices have been widely investigated to reduce the responses of structures under earthquake, including variable orifice dampers, and controllable fluid dampers (e. g. MR dampers). Due to the inherent nonlinear nature and uncertainty of the semi-active control system based on magnetorheological (MR) fluid damper, an improved back propagation (BP) algorithm is proposed, which divides the actual structure model into a mechanism model part and a time-varying error model part. By means of off-line training and on-line modifying, the intelligent control system based on the improved BP algorithm is acquired. It can be used to predict the damping force of MR damper and eliminate the influence of time delay. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulations show that the intelligent control system can efficiently reduce the structure responses induced by earthquake, have good performance in adaptively tracking target and display resistance to disturbances.

articleTitle: Course Construction and E-Learning Design Exploration of Strategic Management Based on Blackboard Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Strategic management is a core course for business administration and related specialties and hence has got immense attention of many universities’ management schools. Integrating authors’ teaching practice of the course, the paper discusses the course construction objectives and teaching innovation measures that have already been taken, introduces practices of double language teaching, case method and Blackboard platform based e-learning of the course. Key issues of next stage construction of the course are put forward in the summary part.

articleTitle: The Framework and Construction of Professional Experiments for Improving Comprehensive Quality: SIFT E-Commerce and Logistics Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: With the through application of information technology in international business and logistics, the society raises new demands to the international business professionals, which has directly leaded to a big change in college education system, especially for business schools. In this paper, based on analyzing the achievement made by the e-commerce and logistics laboratory of Shanghai Institute of Foreign Trade, it will show that the framework of international business school experiment and teaching system reach two purposes. On the one hand, it conducts a series of simulations based on the combination with real practices according to increase the comprehensive-skillful experiment and training the students' major practical ability actively. On the other hand, its construction of the cross-disciplinary coordination and innovation correspond with the needs of improving comprehensive quality.

articleTitle: Classification Method of Network Database Record Based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of database management and intelligence of database record classification, a classification method of network database record based on fuzzy theory is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an automatic classification frame of database is constructed, and then standard record model and special data record and new record model on fuzzy set are given. By calculating the membership of keyword, new fuzzy closeness functions are proposed to classify the information. Finally, examples prove that this algorithm can effectively and automatically classify input information of database, the accuracy and intelligence is better, and can greatly improve information input efficiency of database.

articleTitle: An Approach for the Effective Management of Heterogeneous Learning Resources
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology for the production network laid the foundation for learning. The approach to learning has the transition from computer-assisted learning to Web-based learning. This paper proposed an approach for effective sharing of heterogeneous learning resources. It investigate the status of resource sharing to education, and analysis of the causes of the problem, raised a number of effective strategies to solve the problem, choose the model points in a typical demonstration of regional construction and research.

articleTitle: Study on the Data Preprocessing of the Questionnaire Based on the Combined Classification Data Mining Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: In order to preprocess the questionnaire data, the thoughts of the KDD and some nodes of the Clementine data mining software package are employed in a flexible way and the existing information are made full use of to build the combined classification data mining Model.

articleTitle: Development of E-Government Platform Based on B / S Architecture and Performance Evaluation Program
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: E-government, a product of information technology, is considered as the core projects in the building of information superhighway, and is chosen as preferred solution to improve administrative efficiency and low administrative costs. Therefore, it is becoming a pressing issue to develop an e-government platform with high efficiency and good performance. In combination with the developed e-government platform in China, a noval e-government platform based on both B/S architecture and performance evaluation was constructed in this paper, and the construction of noval platform will provide some references for the highly efficient and healthy development of e-government in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Current Research on Improving Children's English Learning with Computer Technology in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The aim of the paper is to review and analyze research on improving children's English learning with multimedia resources and tools in China, and to propose problems as well trends in them so as to provide reference for successive researchers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Communication Soft Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Mobile communications is an important professional course for telecommunication engineering, so a practical system of mobile communication experiment is essential. Comparing with the traditional experimental teaching, Mobile Communication Soft Laboratory (MCSL) takes advantages of real-time and flexibility. Especially in lack of funds laboratory, MCSL can help learners to understand the principle. MCSL is programmed with VC and MATLAB. This paper is introduced three implemental means of experiments: confirmatory experiment, design experiment and comprehensive experiment. It is effective for students to be applied in experimental teaching.

articleTitle: On the Construction of a Human Resources Management Information System Based on CSCW for Institution of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Office automation has generally been achieved in different departments of universities. So the informatization of human resources management has its good base. But traditional human resources management information system has many shortages. People cannot share its data. Its information cannot be well used. Sometimes people have to work repeatedly. If CSCW is adopted in human resources management information system, it can enhance the cooperation and increase the efficiency of using information. It can help to achieve a high sharing of data and improve the efficiency in human resources management.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Evaluation on Circular Economy Development of Coal Mining Based on Improved Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Circular economy, as an advanced development mode for harmonizing the Problems among resource, environment and economy, is destined to be the choice for coal concerned enterprises to explore new industrial way and keep on developing. The paper eliminated the redundant data in index membership for object classification by defining distinguishable weight and extracted valid values to compute object membership. The improved algorithm of membership degree transformation includes three calculation steps which can be summarized as ¿effective, comparison and composition¿, which is denoted as M(1,2,3). The paper applied the new algorithm in fuzzy evaluation on the circular economy development of coal mining. Evaluation results show the validity of the improved model and the model can achieve the dynamic evaluation of circular economy development of coal mining.

articleTitle: A Note of the Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: We give a stability analysis for the information systems by means of the method of Lyapunov function.

articleTitle: Analysis of E-Commerce Application in Beijing Intellectual Property Agencies: A Case Study of Beijing Wang & Partners Firm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Beijing Wang & Partners firm, a Chinese intellectual property agency to provide legal services to both individuals and companies in China and overseas, was built in 2000. It has set up website to enhance the corporate image, optimize organization structure, simplify the business procedures, improve the work efficiency, and so on. This paper surveys the status quo of e-commerce application in Beijing Wang & Partners firm comprehensively from the perspective of market orientation, management model, function and feature of website. The result indicates that there are some problems in the process of doing e-commerce. Based on the analysis, this paper puts forward with suggestions for Beijing Wang & Partners firm. It is maybe a useful reference to intellectual property agencies in China.

articleTitle: The Application Research on the Visual Data Modeling in the Information System Analysis and Design
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: All the major methods of modeling design in use each have their own characteristics, but none of them can fully satisfied the requirement of architecture data modeling design. To settle this problem, the ideology of visual modeling is introduced to bring into play the advantages of structural analysis method, object-oriented analysis method and model driving architecture method that are applied at different layers of architecture data modeling respectively, so as to solve the concrete problem of each layer with a clear aim. In addition, focusing on visual data modeling, the system of architecture data modeling technology comes into being, and preferable meets the application requirement of large-scaled and complex information system analysis and design.

articleTitle: On the Business Model of Modern Rural Commodity Circulation Network in the Perspective of E-Business
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: Rural commodity circulation network is playing a significant role of ¿one network multi-purpose and two-way circulation¿ in the urban and rural commodity market. Taking the Supply and Marketing Cooperative (SMC), an organization of economic cooperation in China, for an example, this paper proposed a business model for the modern rural commodity circulation network based on extensive and thorough actual survey. That is to strengthen the construction of rural commodity circulation carriers, including the leading enterprises, distribution centers, agriculture product market, recovery network of renewable resources, chain supermarket, franchise stores, direct-sale stores and so on, by using the newly developing e-business technique and information communication technology (ICT) and actively taking the advantages of the SMC as a government functional department. Then, construct and improve the information network of taking the leading enterprises as guide, trading market and distribute centers as support, retail stores as terminal, management information system of rural commodity circulation as supply chain. And ultimately construct a comprehensive rural commodity circulation network on the virtual marketing platform through the e-business of rural circulation.

articleTitle: The Research on Control Algorithm of Logistics Data Exchange Based on XML
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: With more and more applications of XML in logistics data exchange, data security will become increasingly important. In the paper, according to network security related technologies and XML security component technology, data security control method based on XML in logistics data exchange is discussed. More ever, how to strengthen the security of Internet commerce is discussed by instance, and it useful for user, who only needs access to part content of XML document, effectively control XML data access.

articleTitle: Study on the Circulation Development Pattern of Handan's Heavy Chemical Industry Based on Industrial Symbiosis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The industrial symbiosis theory is an effective way to develop circular economy. Based on the theory, the paper analyzed the development status of heavy chemical industry, constructed the circulation development pattern of Handan's heavy chemical industry based on industrial symbiosis, and according to the circulation development pattern, proposed development recommendations and measures of heavy chemical industry to achieve a win-win of economic and environmental benefits of Handan City.

articleTitle: The Characteristics and Defects of the Development of China's Foreign Trade after Accession to the WTO
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: After entering into WTO, China held the good chance of quick development of economic globalization to develop export-oriented economy and promote the rapid development of foreign trade and economy. However, there were some potential defects behind achievements, such as high proportions of foreign-owned enterprises and processing trade in total foreign trade, centralized international markets, lacking independent intelligence right and international brands, and little benefits from international trade. Therefore, only the defects are deeply understood and correctly solved, could the development of Chinese economy and its foreign trade be promoted. Accordingly, this paper made some studies in this field so as to promote the competitiveness of internal enterprises as soon as possible and realize the transfer from "export for earning foreign currency" to "export for earning profits".

articleTitle: Pay Design with University Based on KM and BSC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The paper studied salary system. Using knowledge management (KM), it designs (balance scorecard) BSC of university, and then constructs other three BSC: school BSC, department BSC and teacher BSC. In virtue of KM and BSC, it links university strategy with teacher performance. In the end it designs teacher salary system and gives a case of pay design.

articleTitle: New Information Grey Multi-variable Optimizating Model NMGM(1,n,q,r) of Social Security Level
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on E-Learning, E-Business, Enterprise Information Systems, and E-Government
abstract: The social security level is an important factor during the process of the reformation of social security system. Whether it is fit for the level of the economic development has a crucial impact on the development of the social economy and the stabilization and solidification of our country. Higher or lower social security level influences the development of economics. Based on the Grey system and the new information principle, taking the mean relative error as objective function and taking the modified nth component of each variable as initial value of response function and finding the optimum background value coefficient q and modified value of initial value of response function by optimizing, new information multi-variable optimization Grey model NMGM (1, n, q, r) of the social security level was put forward which is used to check validity with example. Calculation results show that this method is very effective to data processing which has high precision and easy to use. The method has wide applications in social security level fields and other various economic fields.
